trace.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import tomllib, json
print(json.dumps(tomllib.load(open(".agents/release.toml", "rb")), indent=2))
EOF
git fetch origin main && git fetch origin production 2>/dev/null || true; SHA=$(git rev-parse "origin/main^{commit}"); echo $SHA; git log "origin/production..$SHA" --format="%h %s (%an)" --reverse
doctl-harbor apps list --output json | jq -r '.[] | select(.spec.name | test("harbor-web")) | .spec.name'

STARTED=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
gh workflow run deploy-production.yml --ref main -f ref=8dab0d61f24781e25f75946cf16cb5b8febbe4d6 -f dry_run=true
